method: 5 random items per chapter (140), a further 45 random MCQ/short items, and 6 full mock items (grammar set, letter, analytical paragraph, extracts) re-solved by hand against the chapter facts and grammar rules
fixes: vocabulary MCQs with near-synonym distractors removed (rapturous/gleefully, haughtily/proudly, confide/unbosom, excitable/nervous, duplicate 'emancipation', disappointed/glum)
synonym-replacement answers now correct a/an before the new word ('a offer' -> 'an offer')
writing value points now fill template slots ({n} was printed literally)
a letter-to-a-friend prompt marked as a formal letter replaced by a diary prompt

uncertain text details removed before generation (Anne Gregory rhyme scheme, the 'text found last night', the Mijbil 'brontosaurus' guess, Max landing on a ledge, Horace's remark on trust, the Paris setting, Amanda 'go out in the sun')
poetry-extract mock slot restricted to verse extracts; original verse extracts added for Fire and Ice, The Ball Poem and The Trees
pie-chart prompts no longer tie a state-wide topic to a random city
draft-letter items addressed to the Principal now carry school-related subjects
note: No wrong answer keys found in the final sample. All passages, extracts and verses are original; text questions use only well-known facts (author, characters, events, theme).
